activity.overview: Listen to a short text about sunlight and shade. Tell what the sun does.
activity.passage: The sun gives us light. Sunlight also makes things warm. It warms the sand at the beach. It warms the slide at the park. When a tree blocks the sunlight, it makes shade. Things in the shade stay cooler. That is why we like to sit in the shade on a hot day.

questions.prompt: What does sunlight do to the sand?
Is it cooler in the sun or in the shade?
Where do you like to sit on a hot day? Why?

activity.subject: science
activity.title: The Sun Warms Things
